{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue after cleaning
mean_revenue_clean = loyal_completed_clean['revenue'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA orders): {mean_revenue_clean}')"}
